description: Treats a TIME-SERIES text datafile (a plain list of numbers) as a SOUNDWAVE PLOT - sonification by direct waveform reading (input_arity 0; the data file is the source). downsample transposes the data down by whole octaves = timestretch by 2^downsample: at 0, N values render as exactly N samples at 44100 Hz (8000 values -> 8000 frames verified); at 4, x16 (8000 -> 127984 frames); the duration expression names the aux param so the pre-flight skips (engine watchdog guards). UNDOCUMENTED DEFAULT CURTAIL (first-class): without -d the output is silently capped at 10 s (downsample 8 on 8000 values -> exactly 10.000000 s); -d sets the cap explicitly but is CDP-enforced 1 to 60 - NOT the banner's '1 - 600' ('Parameter[2] Value (700.000000) out of range (1.000000 to 60.000000)'; 0.5 also refused). downsample is breakpoint-capable (a 2->6 envelope differs from both scalar endpoints; envelope times are OUTPUT-sound times per the banner). -f loops the data to fill maxdur exactly (verified 20.0 s with -d20; accepted WITHOUT -d despite the banner calling that invalid - silently inert). CUBIC-SPLINE FLAG BROKEN (build-pinned): -c renders a 1-FRAME silent file - excluded from this entry. Data values outside +/-1 are accepted. Deterministic (runs 1.2 s apart byte-identical). Output mono 44100 Hz.
musical_use: The sonification workhorse: ANY column of numbers - sensor logs, stock series, chaotic maps, brownian walks - becomes audio by treating values as samples. At downsample 0 you hear the raw series as a waveform (fast data = noise, correlated data = coloured rumble); each octave of downsample slows the read and drops the pitch, turning statistical texture into audible gesture. Breakpoint downsample to zoom from pitch into rhythm within one render - the series literally decelerates underfoot. -f -d loops short series into steady beds. Pair with tsconvert-style preprocessing upstream (rescale/quantise your data before writing it) and treat the render as raw material for filtering and enveloping. Deterministic, so a dataset is a patch: same file, same sound, every time.

indata.description: REQUIRED text datafile: a plain list of numbers (whitespace/newline separated), read as consecutive waveform samples. ARGV NOTE: this slot precedes the output path ('ts oscil indata outsnd ...') - declared position pre_output so the engine renders it there. Values outside +/-1 accepted. N values at downsample 0 = N samples at 44100 Hz; the LAST-resort duration guards are the 10 s default curtail and the engine watchdog. Write via write_data_file.

downsample.description: Downward transposition in octaves = timestretch by 2^downsample, CDP-enforced 0 to 16 ('Parameter[1] Value (17.000000) out of range (0.000000 to 16.000000)'; -1 refused). BREAKPOINT-CAPABLE (verified: 2->6 differs from both endpoint renders); envelope times are times in the OUTPUT sound.

maxdur.description: Maximum output duration, CDP-enforced 1 to 60 - the banner's '1 - 600' is WRONG ('Parameter[2] Value (700.000000) out of range (1.000000 to 60.000000)'; 0.5 refused too). WHEN OMITTED the cap is silently 10 s (undocumented; verified exact curtail at 10.000000). Entry default 10 mirrors the hidden default.

force_loop.description: Loop the input data to fill maxdur exactly (verified: -d20 -f -> 20.000000 s). Banner says invalid without -d, but the binary ACCEPTS it silently there (inert) - always pair it with maxdur.

examples.description: Hear a logistic-map series raw, then slowed four octaves.
examples.expected_use: Write ~8000 map values first. At downsample 4 the 0.18 s raw burst becomes a 2.9 s texture; render at 0 for the raw noise-view.

examples.description: Loop a short series into a 20-second decelerating bed.
examples.expected_use: Data loops to fill exactly 20 s while the read rate drops 4 octaves across the output.

known_issues: -c (cubic-spline interpolation) is BROKEN on this build: renders a 1-frame silent file (would fail output verification) - excluded from the entry; linear interpolation is what you get.
Silent 10-second curtail when -d is omitted (undocumented; verified exact) - long low-downsample renders stop at 10 s without warning. Set maxdur explicitly.
maxdur is enforced 1-60 s, not the banner's 1-600.
-f without -d is accepted silently (banner says invalid) but does nothing - pair them.
Duration = datacount * 2^downsample / 44100, capped by maxdur - the aux-name duration expression skips the pre-flight; the engine watchdog guards.
Output fixed mono 44100 Hz (no srate/chans parameters). Deterministic (no seed, byte-identical re-renders).

Data-driven entry: process() takes no audio input argument; graph()/batch()/sweep() refuse arity-0 entries (arity_zero_unsupported). Sibling 'ts trace' (data as pitch-trace of a defined waveform) is uncurated.
